summary: Iter210 backend validation of feature bundle 1b+2c+3c (HR payslip full-edit + owner-scoped PDF + director bulk CSV/ZIP exports; donor/vendor auto-create with suggest+drilldown+category validation; backfill idempotency). Wrote 23 pytest cases against production preview URL; 22 passed. One real bug found: POST /api/donors-vendors/backfill is NOT idempotent — re-running creates duplicate donor profiles (24 duplicates on 2nd run in this test env).

minor.issue: Not idempotent: second call created 24 duplicate donor rows. Root cause: dedup lookup in backfill loop uses donation.campus_id (often empty for legacy rows) while upsert_donor_from_donation fills donor.campus_id with current_user.active_campus_id fallback. On subsequent runs the empty-campus lookup no longer matches the previously-created donor and a fresh row is inserted.

Same campus mismatch: donor.campus_id (auto-filled from admin.active_campus_id) is compared against donation.campus_id which is typically absent on POST /financial/donations (only location_id is set). Freshly-created donors returned transactions correctly in this test because both donation and donor derive from the same admin, but for legacy/mixed data the join will silently return empty. Recommend either (a) also setting donation.campus_id on create, or (b) matching donor↔donation via location_id / dropping the campus filter.

action_items: Fix donors-vendors backfill idempotency: in donors_vendors.backfill_donors_vendors(), use the same effective campus (donation.campus_id or admin.active_campus_id) when checking `existing = db.donors.find_one({...})` — mirror the resolution used inside upsert_donor_from_donation. Same for vendors.

Either populate `campus_id` on donation/expense create, OR change donor/vendor transactions & stats queries to match by `location_id` / drop the campus filter so drilldown works consistently across historical rows.
critical_code_review_comments: donors_vendors.py upsert_donor_from_donation and backfill dedup use inconsistent campus keys → duplicate donors on re-run.
financial.py create_donation writes location_id but not campus_id; donors_vendors._donor_stats / donor_transactions gate on campus_id → potential empty drilldown for pre-existing data.
hr.py PUT /payslips/{id} — audit_entry.by_name pulls from current_user['name'] which may be empty for OAuth users; consider falling back to email.
hr.py /payslips/export.zip generates PDFs sequentially via WeasyPrint; for large batches this will exceed request timeout. Consider background job + downloadable link.
hr.py /payslips/{id}/pdf allows owning staff — good; ensure the same policy is applied to /payslips/{id}/mine and any list endpoint so staff can find their payslip id first.

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ staff users, 1 manual payslip (period 2025-01), 2 TEST_ donor rows (via donation POST), 2 TEST_ vendor rows (via expense POST), 2 regression donations/expenses. All prefixed TEST_Iter210_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backfill has been executed 2 more times during this run, so donors collection now contains ~24 duplicate rows for the same historical donation names — please dedupe via `db.donors.aggregate([{$group:{_id:{name:'$name',campus_id:'$campus_id'},dupes:{$push:'$id'},n:{$sum:1}}},{$match:{n:{$gt:1}}}])` before UI drilldown testing. The manual payslip endpoint expects `allowances` and `deductions` as LISTS of {name,amount} objects, not numeric totals.
rca of the issue: backfill_donors_vendors loops over donations with `key = (name.lower(), donation.campus_id or '')` and searches `db.donors.find_one({name..., campus_id: donation.campus_id or ''})`. However upsert_donor_from_donation stores donor.campus_id = donation.campus_id OR current_user.active_campus_id OR '' — so a legacy donation with empty campus_id yields donor.campus_id=<admin's campus>. On the next backfill run, dedup search with campus_id='' fails to find that donor, and a duplicate is inserted. Fix: resolve `effective_campus = donation.campus_id or current_user.active_campus_id or ''` once, use it for BOTH the dedup key and the existing-lookup, mirroring upsert. Same class of bug applies to vendors backfill and to _donor_stats/donor_transactions campus filter.
